note: A quieter week for quotable material: Kimmel remains on break (Ike Barinholtz and Colman Domingo split guest-hosting duties, but no fresh monologue lines surfaced beyond what's already covered in earlier weeks), and Gutfeld! had no solid quotable lines either. The two anchor stories were Trump's much-mocked White House Correspondents' Dinner set from Friday, July 25, and his comment that he understands Venezuela because "Miss Venezuela always did very well" in his old Miss Universe pageant.

videos.title: Kaitlan Collins on How She Handles Trump's Verbal Attacks | The Daily Show

jokes.topic: Trump insulting CNN's Kaitlan Collins at the White House Correspondents' Dinner, then Stewart role-playing how Collins might cover him the same way
jokes.joke: Hey, Tubs. You look pretty today. The Big Beautiful Bill took a million children off of food assistance. Why are your hands so f---ed-up?
jokes.context: Stewart played a Trump-style reporter grilling Collins-as-Trump; when she stayed silent, he added: "Well, the answer is, very clearly, you should smile more. It's the answer to all the questions."

jokes.topic: Trump's poorly-received stand-up set at the White House Correspondents' Dinner
jokes.joke: You cannot judge Trump's whole hour-long special just based on that one joke. Mr. President, what else you got?
jokes.context: Stewart pulled out a toy snare drum and cymbal to supply rim shots for the jokes that didn't land.

jokes.topic: Trump calling "affordability" a Democrat hoax after using it as a core 2024 campaign buzzword
jokes.joke: What do you mean, 'what's affordability?!' You're the one who said it! You said we were going to make America affordable again! 'Affordability' is the noun form of the adjective 'affordable,' you f---ing dropout!
jokes.context: Debuted a new recurring bit for the occasion, called "I Feel F---ing Crazy."

jokes.topic: Trump reportedly scolding RFK Jr. for failing to produce proof of a vaccine-autism link
jokes.joke: Trump is mad that RFK Jr. hasn't produced proof for all of his medical theories… but in RFK Jr.'s defense, there isn't any. He can't find any!
jokes.context: Based on a Wall Street Journal report that Trump told RFK Jr. he was disappointed in his lack of results as health secretary.
